name: @notegen/plugin-api
description: Public TypeScript contract for NoteGen plugins.

scripts.check:contract: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');const pkg=require('./package.json');const source=fs.readFileSync('src/index.ts','utf8');const match=source.match(/PLUGIN_API_VERSION = '([^']+)'/);if(!match)throw new Error('Missing PLUGIN_API_VERSION');if(match[1]!==pkg.notegen.pluginApiVersion)throw new Error('Package contract metadata '+pkg.notegen.pluginApiVersion+' does not match exported plugin API '+match[1]);"
scripts.build: pnpm run clean && pnpm run check:contract && tsc -p tsconfig.json
